summary: Mount Benson once had a summit fire lookout; a 2008 regional park, a closed road and 2026 AI smoke cameras are documented, but no build date.

facts.status_note: No source says whether the old summit lookout still stands; the summit now carries camera equipment on a metal tower.

access.note: Mount Benson Regional Park is entered from a parking lot on Benson View Road; there is no road access to the park itself.

visit.trail_note: Start from the Benson View Road parking lot by Witchcraft Lake; the old access roads have been blocked off.

events.note: Mount Benson Regional Park established on land acquired in 2005 by the Regional District of Nanaimo and the Nanaimo and Area Land Trust
Mosaic Forest Management installed two 360-degree AI smoke cameras on the summit (installed Aug. 4; reported Aug. 19)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The index gives 1021 m for the Benson site; Wikipedia gives 1,023 m for the mountain. The story reports both, with their sources.

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or fire history appears in any source read. The CTV page cache holds only the headline and date, so CTV is cited for the date alone. A search snippet (not read, not cited) says fire rangers once watched from the mountain; verify before using. Follow-up: the BC Forest Fire Lookouts Facebook group's coordinate list, and a BC Archives search for the summit lookout.
